About Us

Committed to Health,
Rooted in Trust

Sri ViiaRx Life Sciences was founded with a clear purpose — to make quality healthcare accessible globally without compromising the environment. We serve as a vital link in the pharmaceutical supply chain, sourcing from GMP-certified partners and delivering to regulatory and non-regulatory markets alike.

Our strength lies in deep industry relationships, rigorous quality checks, and an unwavering commitment to compliance. Whether you need bulk APIs, specialized intermediates, or ready formulations, we ensure every shipment meets the highest standards.

Our Portfolio

What We Trade

End-to-end pharmaceutical sourcing across six key categories, delivered with documentation and logistics support.

APIs / Bulk Drugs

High-purity Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients sourced from audited GMP facilities for formulation and manufacturing needs.

Intermediates

Critical chemical intermediates that serve as building blocks in complex drug synthesis and production pipelines.

Pellets

Advanced multiparticulate systems for controlled release, improved stability, and enhanced patient compliance.

Nutraceuticals

Science-backed nutritional supplements and functional ingredients bridging preventive care and wellness.

Enzymes

Specialized biocatalysts for pharmaceutical synthesis, diagnostics, and industrial bioprocessing applications.

Export Services

Complete regulatory documentation, cold-chain logistics, and customs clearance for seamless global delivery.

Quality Assurance

Built on Global Standards

Every partner facility in our network meets or exceeds international regulatory benchmarks.

US-FDA Approved

Manufacturing partners hold active US-FDA approvals, enabling seamless exports to the United States and aligned markets.

WHO Prequalified

Facilities prequalified by the World Health Organization, ensuring compliance with international quality benchmarks.

GMP Compliant

Stringent Good Manufacturing Practice standards maintained across all partnered production units and warehouses.
